features.name: Z-seam sliding-groove ribbons
features.reason: Each caught face prints down from back-top's ceiling over its open sliding groove. A removable two-wall ribbon stands on the groove floor one empty layer up and stops two empty layers under the caught face; automatic support is blocked on the caught faces and the ribbons, and the solid-host modifiers stop at the ribbons. The 2026-10-10 article's long groove stems were trapped in the walls; the other quadrants' groove supports released easily. enclosure/enclosure/README.md Support-removal strategy; drain-readiness/prints/2026-10-10-current-back-top-bridge50-mark1/physical-result.json.

features.name: Handhold lifting edge fins
features.reason: The handhold lifting edge is a print-down overhang edge on the surface a hand grips. Derek, 942ac2244: "I'm quite convinced that we need to do this everywhere, that we've got these rough edges on overhangs." The accepted faucet-base arcs are faucet/finish-coupons/2026-10-15-edge-supports/base-mark2/physical-result/physical-result.json. Each fin stands on a 0.44 mm foot, 5 mm outboard and 4 mm inboard of it, as its bed anchor: auto_brim gave each bare 0.9 x 22 x 35 mm fin a 15-17 mm brim, which left back-bottom's bead envelope 18.3 mm from the X edges; on feet the slice emits no brim (2026-10-19 Mark2 slice). The inboard foot stops 6.6 mm short of the recess's inner wall. Back-bottom only.

support_object_xy_distance.reason: Two bed-rooted tree trunks rise past the flanks into the hand pockets to carry each pull roof. Where a trunk passes the lower hand-pocket rim, the R6 slopes away under the trunk's edge, so a trunk held 0.4 mm off the rim's slice outline still ran its edge beads within a bead radius of the painted rim (clearance down to -0.07 mm, 2026-10-19 Mark1 slices of the 693f9e26 cartridge). 1.0 mm keeps the trunk off the rim's whole slope. Cartridge-cap plate only.

independent_support_layer_height.reason: Support on the model's own layers: through the 0.08 mm rim band the trunk's beads are 0.08 mm tall instead of 0.28 mm, and the support audit reads each trunk as one bed-rooted body instead of hundreds of one-layer islands. Cartridge-cap plate only.
